summary: In the dojo, Neo charges Morpheus, who praises his 'Adaptation. Improvisation.' but says his weakness 'isn't your technique.' Morpheus then attacks with overwhelming speed, his 'feet and fists are everywhere,' until Neo falls to his hands and knees, spitting blood onto the white floor. Morpheus asks how he won; Neo says 'You're too fast.' Morpheus challenges whether his speed comes from muscles 'in this place,' and whether 'that's air you are breathing now.' Neo stands, 'nodding slowly,' and at Morpheus's command 'Again,' they resume fighting at 'pneumatic speed.'

what_changes.before: Frustrated and defeated, he attributes his loss to Morpheus's physical superiority.
what_changes.after: He begins to accept that the physical laws of the dojo are mental constructs he can bend.
what_changes.evidence: Do you believe that's air you are breathing now? Neo stands, nodding slowly.

what_changes.before: He is beaten to the floor, 'Panting, on his hands and knees, blood spits from his mouth.'
what_changes.after: He rises and re-engages, their 'fists fly with pneumatic speed.'
what_changes.evidence: Neo stands, nodding slowly. MORPHEUS Again. Their fists fly with pneumatic speed.

event_hint.one_line: Morpheus beats Neo and tries to teach him that the physical world is mental.
